note_en: Watch how 从……到…… and 从……走向…… frame change over time: 从步行、马车到高铁、互联网 "from walking and horse carts to high-speed rail and the internet." In English "from... to..." can come anywhere, but in Chinese the whole 从……到…… phrase usually sits before the main verb or clause, setting the scene first. Compare 曾经 "once, used to" (拥有一辆自行车曾经是很多家庭最大的愿望之一), which does the work of English "used to" without any change to the verb.
